<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919310_theRebbe_548" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919310_theRebbe_548__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The Midrash explains that the salvation drawn through Torah is primarily through its letters, which serve as vessels for the Awtsmoos and give life to each Jew.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the Midrash continues,</t>
    <t s="1">Said Rabbi Yitzchak,</t>
    <t s="2">"In You, with the twenty-two letters that You wrote for us in the Torah,"</t>
    <t s="3">That this, that through the Torah the salvation is drawn in the aforementioned manner, is primarily in the letters of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="4">And there are two matters in this.</t>
    <t s="5">For the connection of that which is above nature with nature is through the power of the Awtsmoos</t>
    <t s="6">(as above),</t>
    <t s="7">And the letters of the Torah are vessels for the drawing down of the Awtsmoos</t>
    <t s="8">(as explained in the maamar of the Baal HaGeulah).</t>
    <t s="9">And the vitality of each and every Jew is through his having a letter in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="10">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="11">In order that "we will rejoice and be glad in You"</t>
    <t s="12">(for the matter of joy is the revelation of vitality until the revelation of the innerness of vitality),</t>
    <t s="13">It is through the letters of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="14">From which vitality is drawn to each one of Israel.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Joy breaks boundaries, and the joy of "we will rejoice and be glad in You" in the Awtsmoos itself breaks all boundaries, enhancing the connection of above-nature with nature.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And it is known</t>
    <t s="2">That joy breaks boundaries.</t>
    <t s="3">And it is understood,</t>
    <t s="4">That the boundaries that are broken by joy are only the boundaries of that level in which the joy exists.</t>
    <t s="5">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="6">When the joy in the miracles is from the aspect of the revelations of Memaleh and Sovev</t>
    <t s="7">("day" and "Hashem"),</t>
    <t s="8">Which are in the category of knowledge</t>
    <t s="9">("we do not know"),</t>
    <t s="10">The boundaries that exist in the levels above knowledge still remain.</t>
    <t s="11">However, through the joy of "we will rejoice and be glad in You," in Your very Essence,</t>
    <t s="12">There is made a breaker,</t>
    <t s="13">A breaking of all boundaries.</t>
    <t s="14">And through this there is an additional increase in the connection of above-nature with nature that is made through the revelation of the Awtsmoos.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through joy in this day of redemption, additional enhancement is drawn to the redemption for every Jew, including the future redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is "This is the day that Hashem has made, we will rejoice and be glad in it,"</t>
    <t s="1">That through the joy in this day</t>
    <t s="2">(in the manner of "we will rejoice and be glad in You"),</t>
    <t s="3">There is an additional increase in the redemption,</t>
    <t s="4">Which is in a manner even more elevated than it was the first time</t>
    <t s="5">(as it was drawn from above,</t>
    <t s="6">before the joy).</t>
    <t s="7">And since in the redemption of Yud-Beis Tammuz each and every Jew was redeemed,</t>
    <t s="8">Even those who are called by the name "Israel"</t>
    <t s="9">(only)</t>
    <t s="10">nominally,</t>
    <t s="11">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="12">Also the addition in the redemption each year,</t>
    <t s="13">Which is brought about through the joy of the redemption,</t>
    <t s="14">Is drawn to each and every Jew,</t>
    <t s="15">To be redeemed from all matters that prevent and delay [fulfillment of] Torah and mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="16">And according to the known principle that all redemptions are connected to each other, for all are called "redemption,"</t>
    <t s="17">It can be said,</t>
    <t s="18">That through the joy in celebrating the redemption,</t>
    <t s="19">There will be an addition also in the future redemption,</t>
    <t s="20">"There we will rejoice in Him,"</t>
    <t s="21">In Him, in His very Essence,</t>
    <t s="22">With the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu,</t>
    <t s="23">Speedily, truly.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
